verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official desktop documentation includes dedicated guides to install NVIDIA drivers, build your own NVIDIA kernel modules with the DKMS package, and troubleshoot NVIDIA GPUs and drivers. That covers both halves of the story for the main accelerated-workload GPU vendor. The evidence is only documentation section titles, though, with no content depth. Missing for 10: evidence for vendors other than NVIDIA (e.g. AMD/Intel accelerator stacks), documentation of building arbitrary custom (non-NVIDIA) kernel modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the driver and DKMS workflow works.
